description: A date range with a different price per night (high season, Easter…), for one unit or for all. Nights inside it use this price instead of the unit’s base price. A season for a specific unit wins over one for all units; a night’s own price wins over both. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

min_nights.description: Optional minimum stay for bookings that start in this season (2-60).

unit_id.description: Leave out to apply to all units.

name: add_season
title: Add a seasonal price
